1. (Currently Amended) An immunogenic composition comprising: a modified, live bovine viral diarrhea virus type lb (BVDV-lb) that is __non-cytopathic__, a veterinary-acceptable carrier, and optionally an adjuvant.

2. (Currently Amended) The immunogenic composition of claim 1, wherein the modified, live bovine viral diarrhea virus is a __non-cytopathic__ BVDV-lb virus.

3. (Currently Amended) The immunogenic composition of claim 1, further comprising __one or more modified, live__ [[one or more of a parainfluenza virus Type 3 (PI3), a bovine respiratory syncytial virus (BRSV), a bovine herpes virus (BHV-1), a bovine viral diarrhea virus Type la (BVDV-la), a bovine viral diarrhea virus Type 2 (BVDV-2), or an infectious bovine rhinotracheitis (IBR) virus, or any combination thereof; or one or more viral-specific antigens obtained therefrom.]]__viruses selected from parainfluenza virus Type 3 (PI3), bovine respiratory syncytial virus (BRSV), bovine herpes virus (BHV-1), bovine viral diarrhea virus Type la (BVDV-la), bovine viral diarrhea virus Type 2 (BVDV-2), and infectious bovine rhinotracheitis (IBR) virus, or any combination thereof__.

4. (Currently Amended) The immunogenic composition of claim 1, further comprising __one or more of the following: a modified, live__ [[a modified, live IBRV, a modified, live BRSV, a modified, live BHV-1, a modified, live BVDV Type la, a modified, live BVDV Type 2, or a modified, live PI3, or a combination thereof.]]__non-cytopathic IBRV, a modified, live non-cytopathic BRSV, a modified, live non-cytopathic BHV-1, a modified, live non-cytopathic BVDV Type la, a modified, live non-cytopathic BVDV Type 2, or a modified, live non-cytopathic PI3, or a combination thereof__.

6. (Currently Amended) The immunogenic composition of claim 1, further comprising an immunologically effective amount of at least a first __inactivated microbial pathogen-specific__ antigen.

7. (Currently Amended) The immunogenic composition of claim 6, wherein the at least a first antigen is specific for an organism selected from the group consisting of Actinobacillus, Actinomyces, Bacillus, Bordetella, Brachyspira, Campylobacter, Clostridium, Ehrlichia, Erysipelothrix, Escherichia, Histophilus, Leptospira, Listeria, Mannheimia, Moraxella, Mycobacterium, Mycoplasma, Pasteurella, Salmonella, and Streptococcus, or a combination thereof.

8. (Currently Amended) The immunogenic composition of claim 6, wherein the at least a first antigen is __derived from an inactivated microbial pathogen__.

12. (Currently Amended) The [[vaccine of claim 11]]__immunogenic composition of claim 1__, further comprising an immunologically-effective amount of __at least one inactivated__ microbial pathogen-specific antigen.
